records.context: the well-resize plan (:func:`_well_resize_plan`), ``None`` for off, or ``"settings"`` to read it from ``settings`` without downloading the well detector. When on, each detected well is resized so its longest side is ``side`` pixels (enlargement capped at ``max_factor``), scaled to its 1st/99th percentiles and segmented using the requested diameter in input-image pixels, scaled by the geometric mean of the actual X/Y resize factors. A zero or omitted diameter uses the model's own scale. The plaques are mapped back to original pixels and given unique ids. Model-declared thresholds supply defaults only when ``CP_prob``, ``flow_threshold`` or ``minimum_object_size`` are absent from settings; explicitly supplied values take precedence.

records.translation: áætlunin um stærðarbreytingu brunna (:func:`_well_resize_plan`), ``None`` til að slökkva á henni, eða ``"settings"`` til að lesa hana úr ``settings`` án þess að sækja brunnagreininn.
